answer: Make payouts reversible and a farm loses its upside. Earnings vest over a hundred epochs; within six of any payout anyone may file a bond-backed cluster proof: two keys that reused a nonce or shared a timing signature. A proven cluster forfeits only unvested rewards, re-minted to the prover; vested coin is untouched, so honest error is safe. Because the bounty scales with the cluster, a thousand-key echo is the most profitable thing to prove, while a lone sparrow is not worth framing. Limit: a clone unproven for a hundred epochs keeps all, so this prices haste, not a patient canyon.
